summary.en: Fosun’s pipeline spans oncology, immune-inflammatory and neurodegenerative disease, combining internal development with licensing. It includes antibody/ADC programs and multiple Chinese regulatory submissions.
summary.zh: 复星的管线涵盖肿瘤、免疫炎症和神经退行性疾病,结合内部开发与授权引进。其中包括抗体/ADC项目和多项中国监管申报。

watch.en: September pipeline disclosure reports 54+ oncology programs and 31+ non-oncology programs, counted by indication.
watch.zh: 9月管线披露显示有54个以上肿瘤项目和31个以上非肿瘤项目,按适应症计算。

watch.en: The interim filing identifies GR1803 as licensed, alongside internal small-molecule development.
watch.zh: 中期申报文件显示GR1803为授权引进,同时有内部小分子开发。

watch.en: Nine-month 2026 R&D investment was RMB5.247 billion; innovative-drug R&D was RMB4.346 billion.
watch.zh: 2026年前九个月研发投入为52.47亿元人民币;创新药研发为43.46亿元人民币。

watch.en: Foritinib, GR1803 and adult-NF1 luvometinib submissions require regulatory decisions; decision dates were not verified.
watch.zh: Foritinib、GR1803和成人NF1 luvometinib的申报需待监管决定;决定日期未经核实。

watch.en: AR1001 met the prespecified monotherapy-population significance threshold but not the overall-population threshold; the expanded global option remained unexercised on November 17.
watch.zh: AR1001达到预设的单药治疗人群显著性阈值,但未达到总体人群阈值;截至11月17日,扩大的全球期权仍未行使。

sources: Parent-company 2025 review: HLX43 and luvometinib internal development
FXS7553 independently developed, Phase 2 COPD start, August 13, 2026
AR1001 topline disclosure and unexercised global option, November 17, 2026
AR1001 POLARIS-AD topline results, company release November 17, 2026
gaps: Company phase-by-phase totals were not verified. The pipeline combines pivotal trials and NDA/BLA programs into 32+ and therefore does not support separate phase 3 and registration counts; counts is null.

Most asset phases reflect the August interim report; AR1001 was updated from the November 17 disclosure. The Q3 filing was reviewed for newer context, but current asset-specific changes could not be independently resolved from its extracted text; no claim of a complete November pipeline is made.
English Q3 and interim press-release pages timed out on opening; primary exchange/company filings were used instead. Some pipeline detail is image-based.
Luvometinib is included only for its filed adult NF1 indication, not already approved uses.

AR1001 POLARIS-AD results were disclosed November 16/17, so the obsolete 2026H2 readout was removed. The prespecified monotherapy population met its significance threshold; the overall population did not. No subsequent dated milestone was verified. The November 17 filing says the expanded global option had not been exercised.

HLX43 has an international Phase 2/3 squamous-NSCLC study initiated in May 2026, mapped to 3; this does not establish that every cohort has entered Phase 3. Other solid-tumor trials remain Phase 2. Origins for foritinib, HLX22 and FXS6837 remain null; internal origins were verified for luvometinib, HLX43 and FXS7553. Parent 2025 review predates June 2026 and is used only for provenance.
